purpose: Retrospective nominal twelve-calendar-month research; no prospective issuance or model selection.
target: Exact calendar month M+12; explicit observed finite values only. Missing/unknown/imputed targets remain missing.

models.persistence: Observed origin groundwater; identical to standard annual seasonal naive at twelve months.
models.seasonal_naive: Exact observed target-12 = origin; verify equality and count as ONE effective baseline.

hgb_12month_fixed.justification: Installed sklearn and existing prior fixed HGB settings permit an isolated12month comparator; no new family or tuning. This is a separately fitted regional research model, not the sixmonth lock or approved shadow artifact.

preprocessing: Reuse verified causal origin features, exact3/6monthlags and LOCF<=3 only for training origins. No learned scaling or imputation. XGB/HGB native training missingness; OLS complete training rows. No future weather inputs.
evaluation_common_cases: Before fitting: finite14inputs, observed exact origin/target/seasonal reference, >=12complete same-district OLS trainingpairs before foldcutoff. Every named model uses these exact cases; fail on nonfinite predictions rather than drop cases. Record all excluded slots and reasons.

geographic_sensitivity.full_coordinate_conditional: Retain original fixed-polygon district aggregates without correcting locations or removing errors; names/coordinates conflict so district climate assignment remains uncertain.
geographic_sensitivity.exact_name_coordinate_agreement: Filter each accepted well-month on nonmissing source_name_district_id equal district_id, reaggregate separately, rebuild causal GWLfeatures, copy unchanged existingweather. Apply same prefit common eligibility; not location verification.
geographic_sensitivity.identical_origin_target_panel: Subset full predictions where existing observed panel_sha256 identities match. Panel equality does not certify datum/replacement continuity.
geographic_sensitivity.same_provider_well_baseline: Join target and exact target-12 by agency/providerID; require finite identical latitude/longitude/depth/aquifer/type at BOTH dates. Secondary stratum exact name/coordinate agreement at BOTH dates. Do not fit a well-level MLmodel or use future metadata to rewrite earlier observations.

uncertainty.comparisons: EveryML vs sole persistence/annualseasonalbaseline; matched-target6vs12 for expandingXGB/OLS/baseline, descriptive only. Report absolute and difference intervals.
uncertainty.limitations: Short24month primary and33regionaldistricts are dependent; strict geography only1supported district. No confirmatory/predictive intervals or test-driven selection.

six_month_comparison: Read archived6month outputs only; separately match district+target (sameoutcomes,differentorigins/cutoffs) and district+origin (differentoutcomes). Never label crosshorizon results a controlled treatment effect; no6monthartifact loaded as12.
provenance_limits: All acquisition/publication/receipt/available_at per-value fields unknown; all primary target panels include source name-coordinate conflict; no certified datum/replacement continuity. Standard12calendar target is not proof of12fullmonths from issuance.
allowed_outputs: Only this new report directory and new research module/tests; research artifacts cannot be production/shadow models.
